result.reason: The operative insurance provision meets every preferred requirement and therefore also meets the fallback. It is not minimal because it adds a one-year post-termination maintenance period not required by either position and imposes cyber coverage unconditionally rather than only when Customer Data is processed. These additions concern insurance and do not contradict or impair the existing force-majeure provision.
